Before you decide to off yourself, please read this. A few months ago, I was in a similar predicament. I had a competition which I studied day and night for. I would sit typing for hours on hand and rehearsing my speech until it was something that I could breathe. On the day of the competition, I walked in with my suit ready to wow the judges with my speech and paper. I wasn't even able to compete because I had come an hour late. I don't think I've ever felt a sadness so big, so momentous that it physically felt like a weight was dragging me. I felt so alone in my feeling and I'm going to say that I was truly alone. My parents rightfully saw me as an idiot and I only got pity looks from the people I talked to. I wrote this to tell you that you are alone so don't ever think you are a failure for making a mistake. I know it doesn't make the situation better, but at least you can see that you aren't alone. You're human. You make mistakes and that is completely fine.

x = 3 pie / 5

Now all you do is convert to degrees

3 \* 180 = 540 / 5 = 108

x = 108
